requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement mixes a functional capability (switching filtering ability) with a quality attribute (reliability/availability of management traffic). Per Pohl §25.2, this is decomposed into a functional requirement regarding the routing switch's capability and a quality requirement regarding the reliability of management data traffic.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.object: network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: Routing switches shall switch the ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Extracted the functional capability of the routing switch. The original text implies the switch can toggle or manage the filtering behavior between these two traffic types.

fields.measurable_criterion: management data traffic must remain accessible

structured_requirements.final_statement: Management data traffic (SNMP on UDP port 161) shall remain accessible and reliable.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality concern. The original text implies that the management traffic must be preserved and not disrupted by the switching of filtering abilities. Based on the glossary, this refers to SNMP traffic.
